entries.title: Release 26.10.1-alpha.7 — Ken's Actual fork
entries.body:
**Unofficial fork prerelease.** Based on Actual 26.10.0 (`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`); not an official Actual Budget release.

Schedules can now skip holidays, not just weekends. With **Business calendars** turned on under Settings → Experimental features, a recurring schedule's "Move schedule before/after" option can use one of your business calendars, so a bill or paycheck due on a holiday moves to the nearest business day.
entries.details:
#### Features

- Move a recurring schedule's dates before or after the non-business days of a chosen business calendar, such as U.S. Federal Holidays, instead of only weekends.

#### Enhancements

- Next dates, upcoming dates, account previews, posted transactions, forecasts and budget schedule templates all use the chosen calendar.
- The schedule's description names the calendar, for example "(before non-business days in U.S. Federal Holidays)".
- Editing or deleting a calendar updates the next dates of schedules that use it; undo restores both.

#### Bugfixes

- No fork bug fixes in this release; earlier improvements are retained.

#### Maintenance

- Record schedule business-day behavior as an OpenSpec specification with tests for date moves, previews, templates, the schedule editor and calendar changes.

#### Known limitations

- Experimental and off by default. If a schedule's calendar is deleted, it falls back to weekends and the editor says so.
- Matching bank-imported transactions to schedules is unchanged.
- Business calendars are managed on desktop only; mobile can choose a calendar in the schedule editor.
- Releases published on the same day may show the "What's new" message for any of them; the Notifications page lists all.
- Synthetic staging only; no real financial data or production paperwork migration. No iPhone acceptance test is claimed.

entries.title: Release 26.10.1-alpha.6 — Ken's Actual fork
entries.body:
**Unofficial fork prerelease.** Based on Actual 26.10.0 (`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`); not an official Actual Budget release.

Fork release notes now actually appear on the Notifications page of the web app served by Actual's server. Alpha.5 added them, but its setting only applied to desktop builds, so the server's web app still showed upstream's feed.
entries.details:
#### Features

- No new features; this release makes alpha.5's in-app fork release notes work on the server's web app.

#### Enhancements

- No enhancements beyond the fix below.

#### Bugfixes

- Read the bundled fork and upstream release notes in the web app built for the server (browser build mode), instead of fetching upstream's feed from GitHub.

#### Maintenance

- Verify the bundled feed with the same browser build mode the server image uses.

#### Known limitations

- Releases published on the same day (alpha.4, alpha.5 and alpha.6) may show the "What's new" message for any of them; the Notifications page lists all.
- Fork release cards link to the note on GitHub but are labeled "View on actualbudget.org".
- Upstream announcements after Actual 26.9.0 are not included until the fork merges newer upstream code.
- Schedules using business calendars are not part of this release.
- Synthetic staging only; no real financial data or production paperwork migration. No iPhone acceptance test is claimed.

entries.title: Release 26.10.1-alpha.5 — Ken's Actual fork
entries.body:
**Unofficial fork prerelease.** Based on Actual 26.10.0 (`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`); not an official Actual Budget release.

Fork release notes now appear in the app. Open the bell (Notifications) to read what changed in each fork release, and see a "What's new" message the first time you run a new release.
entries.details:
#### Features

- Show each fork release's notes on the Notifications page, newest first, followed by upstream Actual's announcements included in this build.
- Show "What's new in Actual <version>" the first time a new fork release runs.

#### Enhancements

- Read release notes from the build itself, so a deployment only lists notes for its own and earlier versions and works without reaching GitHub.

#### Bugfixes

- No fork bug fixes in this release; business calendars and earlier mobile and desktop improvements are retained.

#### Maintenance

- Generate the in-app release entries from `fork/release-notes` with `yarn generate:fork-news`; a test fails when a release has no entry.
- Record the rule that every release's notes appear in the app.

#### Known limitations

- Releases published on the same day (alpha.4 and alpha.5) may show the "What's new" message for either one; the Notifications page lists both.
- Fork release cards link to the note on GitHub but are labeled "View on actualbudget.org".
- Upstream announcements after Actual 26.9.0 are not included until the fork merges newer upstream code.
- Schedules using business calendars are not part of this release.
- Synthetic staging only; no real financial data or production paperwork migration. No iPhone acceptance test is claimed.

entries.title: Release 26.10.1-alpha.4 — Ken's Actual fork
entries.body:
**Unofficial fork prerelease.** Based on Actual 26.10.0 (`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`); not an official Actual Budget release.

Adds experimental business calendars, the first step toward paycheck scheduling. Turn on **Business calendars** under Settings → Experimental features, then open **Business calendars** on the desktop Schedules page.
entries.details:
#### Features

- Define business calendars with non-working weekdays, holidays (fixed date, nth weekday or last weekday of a month) and per-year exceptions such as one-off closures.
- Choose how weekend holidays are observed: Saturday to Friday and Sunday to Monday, Sunday to Monday only, or not moved.
- Copy the U.S. Federal Holidays or U.S. Federal Reserve preset and edit it; preview each year's non-business days.

#### Enhancements

- Calendars are stored in the budget, sync between devices and support undo.

#### Bugfixes

- No fork bug fixes in this release; existing mobile and desktop note, split and sync improvements are retained.

#### Maintenance

- Record existing fork behavior as OpenSpec specifications and add tests for desktop note Enter handling and sync-disabled mobile status.
- Add a `business_calendars` table migration; existing budgets are unchanged until a calendar is created.
- Exclude OpenSpec-generated files from formatting checks.

#### Known limitations

- Experimental and off by default; calendars are managed on desktop only.
- Schedules and paychecks do not use calendars yet; that arrives in later releases.
- Holidays tied to Easter must be added as yearly exceptions.
- Synthetic staging only; no real financial data or production paperwork migration. No iPhone acceptance test is claimed.

entries.title: Release 26.10.1-alpha.3 — Ken's Actual fork
entries.body:
**Unofficial fork prerelease.** Based on Actual 26.10.0 (`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`); not an official Actual Budget release.

Build the application and agent API directly from a verified commit on the fork’s development branch, preserving the existing mobile and desktop improvements.
entries.details:
#### Features

- Retain mobile receipt links and explicit synchronization feedback.

#### Enhancements

- Retain multiline transaction notes on mobile and desktop.

#### Bugfixes

- Include the existing awaited API mutations and sparse split-update fixes in the common fork source used by both builds.

#### Maintenance

- Replace patch application with a pinned commit from `kenlefeb/actual` development.
- Verify the checkout, development-branch ancestry and all seven package versions before building.
- Preserve authenticated deployment checks, original transaction IDs, backup hashes and independent restoration checks.

#### Known limitations

- Synthetic staging only; no real financial data or production paperwork migration.
- The commit is deliberately pinned; advancing development does not silently change an existing release.
- No new iPhone acceptance test is claimed by this pipeline release.

entries.title: Release 26.10.1-alpha.2 — Ken's Actual fork
entries.body:
**Unofficial fork prerelease.** For Ken’s synthetic staging evaluation, based on Actual 26.10.0 (`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`). This is not an official Actual Budget release.

Desktop transaction notes now retain and expose multiple lines, including notes created on the phone. This fixes a reproduced desktop editing path that removed line breaks; the original phone-pilot incident has no client event trace establishing its exact origin.
entries.details:
#### Features

- No new product features; this release corrects transaction-note behavior.

#### Enhancements

- Show a multiline desktop note editor. Use Shift+Enter for a new line; Enter and Tab retain table navigation.
- Display the full multiline note on hover even when it fits horizontally. The transaction table retains its compact row layout.

#### Bugfixes

- Replace the single-line desktop input that stripped newlines when editing or blurring a note.
- Keep typing and arrow keys inside the multiline editor; retain beneficiary tag completion and existing quick-entry shortcuts.

#### Maintenance

- Add failing-before/fixed-after regressions for newline preservation, multiline editing and full-note previews.
- Extend browser acceptance to edit a mobile split without changing its parent or sibling, then edit the same multiline parent note on desktop.
- Align all seven package versions and Settings on `26.10.1-alpha.2` and include the desktop regressions in release CI.

#### Known limitations

- Synthetic staging only. No migration of real financial records or production paperwork.
- This release prevents the reproduced newline loss; it cannot infer missing line breaks in arbitrary historical notes.
- Automated mobile-browser checks do not replace acceptance on Ken’s installed iPhone PWA.

entries.title: Release 26.10.1-alpha.1 — Ken's Actual fork
entries.body:
**Unofficial fork prerelease.** Maintained for Ken’s synthetic staging evaluation; this is not an official Actual Budget release. Based on [Actual 26.10.0](https://actualbudget.org/blog/release-26.10.0/) (`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`).

This first versioned fork release improves mobile notes, receipt navigation and sync feedback, and makes the customized version visible in Settings.

- Open receipt links from mobile transaction notes without copying the URL.
- See a persistent mobile synchronization status and control.
- Preserve line breaks while editing parent and split notes.
entries.details:
#### Features

- Add a persistent mobile Sync/status bar and tappable external note links. Source: `3b1a54d`.

#### Enhancements

- Use multiline mobile parent and split note editors.
- Align the seven release packages and Settings on `26.10.1-alpha.1`; retain upstream provenance separately. Source: `cda16fb`.

#### Bugfixes

- Await refresh completion and clear the busy state after failure.
- Prefer completed sync events over cached startup connectivity after an offline launch.

#### Maintenance

- Add semantic prerelease guards and automated Settings-version acceptance.
- Verify the $901 synthetic fixture, two splits and exact IDs/notes after deployment and independent restoration.
- Publish a separate API-client maintenance artifact with asynchronous completion and sparse-split mutation fixes; this is not a new production agent service.

#### Known limitations

- Synthetic staging only; no real-budget migration or production document authorization.
- Phone receipt tapping passed. Multiline phone editing and the wider mobile pilot remain open.
- The existing demo-based mobile prefill setup remains unresolved; focused native-budget browser acceptance passes.
